description: This Java source file implements the data access object (DAO) for ProductAttribute entities, providing methods to retrieve product attributes from the database based on various criteria. It uses QueryDSL for type-safe queries within a Spring-managed repository.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductAttributeDao interface for database operations related to ProductAttribute entities using QueryDSL within a Spring Repository context.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute entity by its ID, performing joins to fetch related product options, values, descriptions, and merchant store details.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches a list of ProductAttribute entities associated with a specific product option ID and merchant store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Fetches ProductAttribute entities matching a list of attribute IDs for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttribute entities associated with a specific option value ID and merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Fetches ProductAttribute entities related to a specific Product, considering the store and language context.
